metadata.changelog: v2.0.0: Added 17 structural patterns from blader/humanizer (Wikipedia AI Cleanup). Added German banned words, patterns, and auto_corrections.

description: Rewrites AI-sounding text to clear, specific human voice. Removes buzzwords, clichés, and formulaic patterns in English and German while preserving original content, ideas, and structure. Based on Wikipedia Signs of AI Writing guide (29 patterns).

banned_words.description: Words that must be removed or replaced with short, concrete language

in_a_world_where.detect: In a world where [scary/overwhelming change], [virtue/edge] becomes [currency/advantage]
in_a_world_where.detect_de: In einer Welt, in der... / In der heutigen Zeit...

most_people_vs_few.detect: Most people [lazy thing]. The few who win [disciplined thing].
most_people_vs_few.detect_de: Die meisten... Doch die wenigen, die...

stop_start_switch.detect_de: Hören Sie auf mit... Fangen Sie an mit...
rewrite_options: If you're doing [X], switch to [Y] when [condition], because [reason].

journey_narrative.detect_de: Die Reise von [A] nach [B]... / Der Weg von...
rewrite_options: Moving from [A] to [B] took [time/effort]. Here's what changed: [specifics].

embrace_the_future.detect_de: Setzen Sie auf [Trend], um wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben
rewrite_options: Use [specific tool/method] for [specific benefit]. Example: [concrete case].

significance_inflation.detect: marking a pivotal moment in the evolution of...
significance_inflation.detect_de: markiert einen Meilenstein in der Entwicklung von... / stellt einen Wendepunkt dar
significance_inflation.fix: State the plain fact. 'was established in 1989 to collect regional statistics'

copula_avoidance.detect: serves as... / features... / boasts... / stands as... / functions as...
copula_avoidance.detect_de: dient als... / zeichnet sich aus durch... / fungiert als... / besticht durch...
copula_avoidance.fix: Use 'is' or 'has'. Direct verbs over fancy circumlocutions.

negative_parallelism.detect: It's not just X, it's Y / It's not about X, it's about Y / ..., no guessing
negative_parallelism.detect_de: Es geht nicht nur um X, sondern um Y / Nicht nur... sondern auch...
negative_parallelism.fix: State the point directly without the theatrical setup.

rule_of_three.detect: innovation, inspiration, and insights / ideate, iterate, and deliver
rule_of_three.detect_de: Innovation, Inspiration und Insights / planen, umsetzen und optimieren
rule_of_three.fix: Use the natural number of items. Don't force triplets.

synonym_cycling.detect: protagonist... main character... central figure... hero (cycling synonyms for same thing)
synonym_cycling.detect_de: Lösung... Ansatz... Konzept... Methode (for the same thing)
synonym_cycling.fix: Pick one term and repeat it. Repetition is clearer than forced variation.

false_ranges.detect: from the Big Bang to dark matter / from ideation to deployment
false_ranges.detect_de: von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung / vom Konzept bis zum Produkt
false_ranges.fix: List the topics directly instead of implying a spectrum.

em_dash_overuse.detect: Excessive use of em dashes (—) for parenthetical asides
em_dash_overuse.fix: Prefer commas, periods, or parentheses. One em dash per paragraph max.

boldface_overuse.fix: Remove bold from inline terms. Bold is for headings, not emphasis carpet-bombing.

inline_header_lists.detect: **Performance:** Performance improved / **Speed:** Code generation is faster
inline_header_lists.fix: Convert to prose. If it repeats the header word, the header was unnecessary.

title_case_headings.fix: Use sentence case: 'Strategic negotiations and partnerships'

persuasive_authority_tropes.detect: At its core... / What matters is... / The key takeaway is...
persuasive_authority_tropes.detect_de: Im Kern... / Entscheidend ist... / Die zentrale Erkenntnis...
persuasive_authority_tropes.fix: State the point directly. The reader decides what's 'core'.

signposting_announcements.detect: Let's dive in / Here's what you need to know / In this article we will...
signposting_announcements.detect_de: Schauen wir uns das genauer an / Im Folgenden werden wir...
signposting_announcements.fix: Start with the content. No throat-clearing.

excessive_hedging.detect: could potentially possibly / it might arguably be said that
excessive_hedging.detect_de: könnte möglicherweise unter Umständen / es liesse sich argumentieren, dass
excessive_hedging.fix: Pick one hedge word or commit to the claim.

generic_conclusions.detect: The future looks bright / Exciting times lie ahead / In conclusion...
generic_conclusions.detect_de: Die Zukunft sieht vielversprechend aus / Es bleibt spannend / Zusammenfassend lässt sich sagen...
generic_conclusions.fix: End with specific plans, facts, or next steps. Or just stop.

at_the_end_of_the_day.pattern: at the end of the day

heres_what_you_need.pattern: here's what you need to know

on_startup.message: Anti-AI voice context loaded (v2.0 + humanizer patterns). Will detect and replace AI-sounding language in EN and DE.

preferences.audit_pass_description: After first rewrite, do a second pass checking for any remaining AI-isms that slipped through
